contacts.name: Open Skies — Events Office
contacts.choicePrompt: Open Skies, events office. What would you like to ask?

greeting.speaker: You
greeting.text: I’m making enquiries about the New Horizons reception.

greeting.speaker: Events coordinator
greeting.text: I organised it. What would you like to know?

fallback.speaker: Events coordinator
fallback.text: I don’t have information that connects those details.

fallbackVariants.speaker: Events coordinator
fallbackVariants.text: I don’t have information that connects those details.

fallbackVariants.speaker: Events coordinator
fallbackVariants.text: That is not something I can confirm from the event records.

fallbackVariants.speaker: Events coordinator
fallbackVariants.text: I’m afraid I can only speak about matters handled by this office.

fallbackVariants.speaker: Events coordinator
fallbackVariants.text: I don’t have anything further to add on that subject.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Could you give me Claire Sutton’s telephone number?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: I’m sorry, we do not give out private telephone numbers. You can contact Claire through her work email.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: What is Claire Sutton’s work email address?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: She handles regional enquiries at claire.sutton@openskies.local.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Thank you. I’ll write to her.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Is Nora Bell the woman on the right in the reception photograph?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: Yes. Nora Bell coordinates our North Region. That photograph was taken before the evening reception.
fragments: coordinates our North Region. That photograph was taken before the evening reception.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Nora is wearing a green checked jacket in the photograph. Do you remember it?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: Yes. That is Claire’s jacket. Claire Sutton lent it to Nora after Nora spilled coffee on her blouse.

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: Nora returned the jacket to Claire immediately after the photograph. I saw her hand it back while I was ushering everyone into the reception.

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: Fortunately the photographer left before the second coffee incident.

lines.text: What can you tell me about Claire and the green checked jacket?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: It belongs to Claire. She lent it to Nora for the photograph. Nora returned the jacket to Claire straight afterwards. I saw the handover.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: What is Claire Sutton’s role at Open Skies?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: Claire Sutton coordinates the West Region: community partnerships and volunteer training.
fragments: coordinates the West Region: community partnerships and volunteer training.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: What does Nora do at the foundation?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: Nora Bell handles small grants and outreach in the North Region. She spends a great deal of time explaining that a grant application is not a shopping list.
fragments: handles small grants and outreach in the North Region. She spends a great deal of time explaining that a grant application is not a shopping list.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Did your office organise New Horizons?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: Yes. Registration, workshops and the evening reception. Also seventeen seating plans, all apparently final.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: What does the foundation do?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: We support local projects with grants, training and partnerships. Our events bring the regional teams together.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Do you keep a record of what delegates wear?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: No. Seating plans are quite enough paperwork. I only remember clothing if something happened to it.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Was the conference held at Hotel Miramar?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: The workshops were in the Bellini Room and the reception was on the west terrace. I can discuss the event, not the hotel’s guest list.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Did the New Horizons programme include a reception at Miramar?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: Yes. Afternoon workshops in the Bellini Room, then the west terrace. Accommodation bookings were handled separately.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Did your office organise an event at The Mariner?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: The event I organised was at Miramar. I do not manage The Mariner’s calendar.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Can you tell me about the Coral Crown Hotel?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: I do not handle their bookings. My role here is event administration for the foundation.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Who arranged the reception photographs?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: We commissioned Martin Cole. The public gallery contains the photographs cleared for publication. Private albums are not handled by this office.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Why does the foundation use a swallow emblem?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: It represents movement, cooperation and a place to return to. The designer explained it more elegantly. At considerably greater length.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: What is your policy on work contact details?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: We can provide appropriate work contact information for a named colleague. Private numbers and personal messages remain private.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Have I reached the events office?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: Yes. Conference arrangements and public event enquiries. The grant application deadline is still the grant application deadline.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Were the orange badges used at New Horizons?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: Orange passes were issued to delegates. Speakers and volunteers had grey passes. A badge colour alone does not tell you someone’s name.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Was Claire attending New Horizons as part of her work?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: She is one of our regional coordinators. The programme brought the regional teams together.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Does that include staying at the hotel?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: We handled the event. Rooms were booked separately. I booked a projector, not everyone’s bedtime.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Could you pass a private message to Claire?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: You can write to her work address. I can pass on an ordinary office message, but I will not repeat a private allegation over the reception desk.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I haven’t made an allegation.

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: Excellent. We have both had a productive call.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: May I have Nora Bell’s private number?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: No. We do not give out staff members’ personal numbers.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Even for an enquiry?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: That is generally when people ask for them.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: You saw Nora give the jacket back. What happened immediately afterwards?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: I was getting people into the reception. Nora handed it to Claire while we were moving everyone along.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Could the photograph show what either of them wore later?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: It shows the moment the photographer took it. He was good, but not that good.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I have a photograph of a table. Could you tell me who was sitting with Claire?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: Not from that description. Have you spoken to her?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I am trying to establish what happened at the reception.

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: Then I can answer questions about arrangements I handled. I was not taking attendance at every glass.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Can you tell me whether Daniel Reed attended?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: I cannot disclose individual registration details to an unidentified caller.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I am a private investigator.

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: That identifies your profession. It does not authorise me to read you our records.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Could your office confirm Daniel Reed’s room booking?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: No. Hotel accommodation was separate from our event arrangements.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: So you would not have his room details?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: Correct. I was responsible for the seating plan. That was already more intimacy than I wanted.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Were all the people with orange delegate passes foundation employees?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: Orange indicated a delegate. It was not an employee identification card.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: And the grey passes?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: Speakers and volunteers. The colours helped us manage the event. They did not replace introductions.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Were the published photographs taken during dinner?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: The photographs of the coordinators were taken before the evening reception.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Was everyone already seated?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: No. I was still ushering people in. Getting a group photograph and getting that group to move are separate professional disciplines.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: If someone attended the reception, would their accommodation be part of your booking?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: Not automatically. The workshops and reception were our arrangements. Accommodation was handled separately.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Could somebody attend without staying overnight?

lines.speaker: Events coordinator
lines.text: Attending our event did not require me to book them a room. We are a foundation, not a package holiday.
